items.description: Greener pastures ranks U.S. cities based on the greenness of their available housing stock. In a graph, each line represent a city's greenness over time. You can hover over a line to see which city it represents and compare.
Track FedEx packages--with per-segment CO2 estimates.

IndiaTweetz- Tweets and News about India- is a one stop Twitter based portal to tap the buzz in India.Tweets are categorized in groups like Headlines,Cricket,Politics,Business, Bollywood,Celebrities,Cities etc.
Start typing keywords and products will appear instantly with descriptions and price details. Search Amazon's entire catalog. Instantly.

Psykotube is a great way to browse lots of videos really quickly. With Really simple and neat interface. This is great to get an overall vibe of a search and is at times faster than youtube's own search tool!
A Google map that plots The New York Times column 36 Hours. This column offers a weekend-long itineraries different North American cities. Click markers to browse columns from the past 3 years.
Google Maps Mashup of vacation and travel information in Germany.
Zenoss Core is an open source systems management platform that monitors your whole infrastructure. Starting with version 2.1, all geographical network data is overlaid on Google Maps.

ChristmasListApp.com is a free online and mobile tool for making and managing Christmas gift lists. Add gifts to your wish lists from any site with the Christmas List App web application or Chrome Extension. Or add gifts by searching popular eCommerce sites like Amazon, ebay, and Walmart. Christmas List App also allows you to easily share your wish lists with family and friends.
Ranks one-hit wonders, taking music listening stats from Last.fm.

A PowerPoint mixer to select a PowerPoint presentation on the fly from SlideShare. It uses the SlideShare.net API and pretty effects by script.aculo.us and prototype.js to select a random slideshow for a given tag.

This map and table application displays historical and cultural monuments in Los Angeles, with a focus on monuments that celebrate diversity, democracy, and freedom. Includes descriptions and Flickr photos for over 900 monuments.
SendShorty is a Short Message Service (SMS) for business. Uses Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.
Job Search Website for passive job seekers. This service lets you list your ideal job and have recruiters do all the work for you.

Viamigo helps travelers, journalists and travel professionals find authentic, local experiences and insider adventures, by connecting them with travel services everywhere. Integrates the Rezgo XML API into the Bookable Tours section.
Share code with developers through Twitter. Provided as a plugin for Eclipse (initially), use it to select a file or snippet of text in an editor and share it on Twitter.

Using your Facebook login, explore the rich content of our website that is integrated with Facebook Connect and Application. Find your character by browsing through hundreds of personality quizzes and more.

CampusBird is the first interactive 3D and Maps-based school search site. Search for schools by name, location, scene, weather, school size, and more. CampusBird provides in depth profiles of more than 4800 schools and hundreds in 3D. Formerly called Egiate.
Monitor anything important to you on the web with SMS - track classifieds postings, job boards, RSS feeds. If you own a business, track new orders, purchases, sign ups, etc.
Your professional world, visualized. Map your professional network to understand the relationships between you and your connections.
Nice mashup of the NOAA Weather Service API and Google Maps. Enter an address and get detailed forecasts.
Search for commercial properties that are for sale across the United States.
MountainsMounts.com provides over 100,000 mountain peaks geo information and shows the mountains on a map.
It allows users to have a little more fun with their lists by having them read back via browser or phone. Share lists and collaborate with others.
dr. Nescio is a application that automatically indexes and ranks cities based on individual sights, like museums, parks, hotels, bars and music venues.
Golf course and syndicated golf news. Integrated Google Calendar lets you see upcoming events.

A portal for the UK's leading live entertainment locations featuring traditional theaters, concert halls, night clubs, arenas etc.. Listed by county or region. Simply select your chosen area from the menu and click on Visit Website, which will be displayed on the map.
Google Picasa image search, in Turkish language. Uses GoogleAjaxFeeds to show latest searches.
Create your own Twitter live backchannel instantly on any Twitter search query. Handy for events and or social tv.

Piracy Watch visualizes piracy incidents around the globe from 1978 to present, displaying the data in both a map and timeline. The visualization also includes a heat map to give immediate understanding of what parts of the world have been most impacted.
Convert url to full size image or thumbnail in batch. Capture webpages/websites screenshot from their URLs in batch. Make images of web pages (convert web pages to images) in batch.
Quickly find campus buildings with this campus map of the University of Texas at Austin.
